content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm new to [product_name] and I'm trying to use the arrow button function (Cx function) within the automation software. However, I'm unsure how to access all four arrow buttons while the software is running. When [product_name] is operational, pressing the ESC button takes me directly to the main menu (e.g., Stop, etc.). Thanks in advance for any assistance. Have a great day.

First, you need to navigate to the correct screen. If you're at the main screen (showing date/time), press the left arrow once and you'll be presented with a screen displaying both ESC+ and the arrow buttons. The arrow buttons are accessible only from this screen. It's important to press ESC and the arrow button exactly at the same time. This can require some practice! Good luck!
Thank you, [user_name], your explanation was very detailed.

Additionally, you can use the cursors like inputs in your application. To operate, press ESC and a cursor key simultaneously. This works with the cursor keys on both the base module and the operator device. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report challenges when trying to access and use the arrow button (cursor) feature on [product_name] during operation. The main issue is that the method of accessing this feature is not clearly explained, and pressing ESC together with the arrow key can be unintuitive and difficult to perform. Experienced contributors elaborate that correct screen navigation and timing of key presses are crucial, highlighting a less user-friendly interface regarding this function.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the arrow button (cursor) functionality to be simple and easy to use during program execution, and would appreciate clearer instructions or a more intuitive process for accessing these features.
